_about: Every public-domain John Calvin (1509-1564) English text the Word Hoard holds beyond the Commentaries. The 45 Calvin Translation Society commentary volumes are already held through CALVIN_COMMENTARIES in pipeline/fetch_sources.py (census 2026-10-02: complete, Genesis to the Catholic Epistles; Calvin wrote no commentary on Revelation and his Ezekiel stops at ch. 20), listed under _held. Added here as verified gaps: the Institutes in Henry Beveridge's Calvin Translation Society translation (1845) and A Treatise on Relics (tr. Krasinski, 1854), clean from CCEL; the Letters (ed. Jules Bonnet, Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1858), vols. 1-2 clean from Gutenberg and vols. 3-4 as IA OCR; and the Tracts Relating to the Reformation (Calvin Translation Society, tr. Beveridge, 1844-1851, 3 vols; title-page years read from the OCR) as IA OCR, raw and unconverted.

_translator_not_in_text.calvin-tracts-1: Beveridge (claimed, not checkable): vol. 1's OCR never names Beveridge (its title page is not in the text layer); vols. 2-3 of the same Calvin Translation Society series name him, and IA's record for vol. 1 credits Beveridge (Calvin Translation Society, 1844).
